method: Deterministic arithmetic over the two UNDRR/WMO source-reported framework counts; no country-level records, activation-level records, or causal model are used.
interpretation_boundary: These values are aggregates reported by UNDRR/WMO; NOEMA has not obtained the underlying country-level or activation-level records.
The framework growth percentage is arithmetic over the two source-reported counts and does not independently validate the source's framework inventory.
The 9.6 million figure is reported direct reach; it is not a measured count of comprehension, feasible protective action, independently verified behaviour, or avoided loss.
The USD 119.9 million figure is pre-arranged financing, not necessarily disbursed expenditure and not a per-person cost estimate.
Active frameworks, activation events, countries and people reached are different units; they must not be divided or conflated to infer effectiveness.
